Weldmetrix GmbH is an Austrian high-tech SME founded in 2021, specializing in intelligent process monitoring solutions for laser-based manufacturing. The company develops modular hardware and software systems for in-situ quality assurance, including high-speed optical sensors (WLDR series) and the PROMOS software platform for real-time data acquisition, analysis, and control.
Weldmetrix solutions are used in advanced industrial applications such as laser welding, cladding, and additive manufacturing — supporting customers in automotive, aerospace, and e-mobility sectors. The company’s technology enables digital twins, process traceability, and AI-driven defect detection, contributing to higher process reliability and reduced material waste.
Headquartered in Vienna, Weldmetrix operates within a strong R&D ecosystem, collaborating with leading research institutes such as TU Wien, SKZ, and the Center for Digital Production. Its multidisciplinary team combines expertise in optics, electronics, software engineering, and applied physics, focusing on scalable and integrable solutions for Industry 4.0 and future space-related manufacturing applications.

entityDescription:
Portolan Association, established in 2021 and based in Geneva, Switzerland, is a non-profit organization focused on the monitoring of water resources and climate to support integrated water resources management. Its core activities include hydrometeorological monitoring, hydraulic analysis, and the improvement of water data availability for end-users and decision-makers. Portolan works across diverse geographic contexts, with a particular emphasis on data-driven approaches to support sustainable water governance and climate adaptation strategies.
Portolan collaborates closely with leading academic institutions such as the Technical University of Munich (TUM), University of Fribourg, Brunel University, University of Twente, Grenoble University, Delft Technical University, and the Central Asian Institute for Applied Geosciences. These partnerships have enabled Portolan to carry out extensive fieldwork and applied research, contributing to both academic knowledge and practical applications in water and environmental management.
Portolan has also contributed to the preparation of ecosystem research and restoration, particularly in relation to the monitoring of Nature-Based Solutions (NbS) and their performance under varying hydrological conditions. Our expertise spans mountainous regions, wetlands, and river basins.
The association’s strength lies in its interdisciplinary approach, combining hydrological and climate monitoring (including soil moist, snow and groundwater where relevant) with the analysis of impacts of hydraulic structures on lakes and rivers. This enables us to support adaptive water management practices that are responsive to both environmental variability and infrastructure dynamics.

entityDescription:
LifeWatch ERIC is the European e-Science Infrastructure for Biodiversity and Ecosystem Research, set up as a European Research Infrastructure Consortium (ERIC) under EU law in 2017. Headquartered in Seville, Spain, it brings together contributions from several member countries to provide the scientific community with advanced digital tools and services. Its mission is to integrate data, models, and research capacities across Europe to help address pressing environmental challenges such as climate change, habitat loss, invasive species, and the sustainable management of natural resources. By offering interoperable and open access to data and services, LifeWatch ERIC plays a central role in strengthening the European Research Area.
Through its virtual research environments, high-performance computing resources, and advanced data integration services, LifeWatch ERIC enables scientists and policymakers to better understand, monitor, and protect biodiversity and ecosystems. It supports cutting-edge research, fosters innovation in environmental management, and builds capacity through training and collaboration, ultimately acting as a bridge between science, governance, and society.

description:
EOS is a global company belonging to the EOSOL Group and provides engineering, supervision and technical assistance services. Formed by a large multidisciplinary team with a presence in more than 40 countries, EOS operates in strategic sectors such as energy, industry, railway, telecommunications, aerospace and defence sectors. 
Our team has over 20 years of experience in the aerospace sector. Our team has worked for the main satellite integrators in Europe and has experience in participating in and managing space and defence projects. We also develop projects for the European Space Agency (ESA) both as prime and sub-contractor. 
We are experts on radio-frequency covering the whole spectrum from low up to THz frequencies. We supply engineering services and radio frequency equipment to the main integrators in the space, defence and aeronautical sectors. Among other services, we carry out the manufacturing, assembly and verification of RF communications components and subsystems. Some examples are the development of light aerial systems for SATCOM or HAPS applications, high efficiency feeds for communication satellites and high performance antennas for different applications. We cover the entire life cycle of the project from the feasibility study and design to the manufacturing, assembly and verification, so we can offer our customers a comprehensive solution.
entityDescription:
We have a team of engineers with more than 25 years of experience in the aerospace sector. Our team has worked for the main satellite integrators in Europe and has experience participating and managing space and defense projects. Some of them co-funded by the European Space Agency (ESA).

entityDescription: Delphea is a technology company specialized in the development of the European ECORCE TCAD tool, an advanced simulation software designed to model and predict the impact of radiation on semiconductor devices, including Total Ionizing Dose (TID), Total Non-Ionizing Dose (TNID), and Single Event Effects (SEE). Combining a powerful dynamic mesh generator with high-accuracy algorithms, ECORCE enables efficient multidimensional simulations in a single run, supporting industries where reliability under harsh environments is critical, such as aerospace, space exploration, nuclear energy, medical technology, and automotive electronics. Founded in 2019 with roots at the University of Montpellier, Delphea also provides consulting, case studies, and training, bridging simulation with experimental data to help organizations analyze radiation sensitivity, interpret test results, qualify new devices, and improve overall robustness in extreme conditions.

description: Synchronous Science is on a mission to equip defence and national-security leaders with clear, actionable insights into electromagnetic sensing and communication challenges. Through a systems-thinking approach and extensive engineering expertise, we swiftly identify hidden vulnerabilities and untapped opportunities
entityDescription:
We perform research and development on a broad range of defence-related electromagnetic problems. These have included studies of the threats and vulnerabilities of contemporary and novel communication systems, including 4G LTE and 5G NR cellular, and the increasingly popular Internet of Things technologies such as LoRA and SigFox. A particular focus has been their potential use in adversaries' triggering mechanisms of RCIEDs and how to thwart this. In addition, we are interested in the resurgence of modern HF systems, the prediction of propagation-related phenomena, and the transmission of RF and microwave over optical links. Additional work has included the agile design and implementation of novel RF test and measurement environments over short timescales. 

Outside of work on communication systems, we have performed research into improved intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition, and reconnaissance techniques in synthetic aperture radar and optical domains. This has included research into the theoretical design and practical characterisation of novel low-observable materials. 

Our director has a PhD in Optoelectronics, an MSc (with distinction) in Communication Systems Engineering and a BSc in Mathematics. He has a solid theoretical, computational and experimental physics and engineering background and has contributed to academic and industrial works. He has also obtained memberships of the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), Institute of Physics (IoP) and Institute of Mathematics and Its Applications (IMA), as well as being a corporate member of ADS Group and Team Defense Information. 

We enjoy meeting with customers and suppliers to develop new generation-after-next solutions. Technological advancements are only made through discussions with the end-user.

DMT-LB operates as a regional, national and international enterprise in the fields of science, education and culture.
The German Mining Museum in Bochum and the University of Applied Science Georg Agricola (THGA) are the two legally dependent organisations of DMT-LB. THGA offers courses in the scientific fields of georesources and process engineering, mechanical engineering and materials science, electrical engineering/information technology, and industrial engineering. The Post-Mining Research Centre is also part of the THGA and conducts
interdisciplinary investigations to organize the complex tasks of mine closures and their subsequent usel.

entityDescription:
Epona AI Labs is an Irish deep-tech company based in Kinsale, Co. Cork, focused on developing next-generation contextual acoustic sensing systems for industrial applications. The company’s core innovation lies in fusing AI-driven acoustic analysis with environmental intelligence derived from ESA Sentinel satellite data. This approach enables more accurate machine health monitoring and hazard detection in complex environments such as quarries, construction sites, and agricultural settings.
Founded in 2023 by a multidisciplinary team with expertise in AI, acoustics, and industrial technology strategy, Epona is committed to building scalable, energy-efficient sensing solutions that operate effectively in visually degraded and remote locations. The company is currently advancing its prototype toward commercial deployment and has secured strategic collaborations with industry leaders and research institutions.
Epona has been awarded a grant from ESA BIC Ireland to support the integration of satellite data into its sensing platform, accelerating its development and market readiness. Through a combination of R&D, strategic IP development, and pilot deployments, Epona aims to position itself as a European leader in satellite-enhanced industrial sensing solutions.

entityDescription:
RELOC provides customers with a full spectrum of engineering services in order to build cutting-edge, robust Internet-of-Things (IoT) consumer products and secure industrial machine-to-machine (M2M) applications.
Depending on the customer specific needs, RELOC builds vertical IoT solutions, starting with the analysis of requirements, identifying the best technologies for the project, developing custom hardware or integrating existing components, creating wireless infrastructures based on the most suitable communication protocols, developing firmware and software components, manufacturing complex prototypes based on different technologies, gathering data on Cloud platforms for further analysis and, eventually, presenting contents via responsive web interfaces and mobile APPs.
We believe in connecting the physical world to the internet, supporting the creation of original products and innovative services.

Founded in 2024 by Dr. Agnieszka Łukaszczyk, hiALtitude Consulting harnesses nearly two decades of experience in the space sector, spanning NGOs, public institutions, and industry. Dr. Łukaszczyk and her team brings a comprehensive understanding of space policy, security, Earth observation, and space applications. That and additional expertise from our experts is enabling hiALtitude to support clients across all facets of the space industry.
Driven by a dedication to making a positive impact, we believe that everyone has the potential of building a strong business while contributing to a better world – and hiALtitude is here to support you in that mission.
What sets us apart from other consulting firms is our unique focus on both SPACE and DEFENCE & INTELLIGENCE (D&I). We know those sectors well and we are extremely well connected. We believe that by empowering our clients, we enhance the entire ecosystem of space actors. Our agility allows us to not only adapt to emerging challenges but also to anticipate them, transforming new initiatives into success stories.
Our genuine curiosity about people and the world allows us to build strong relationships, cohesive teams, and vibrant communities. We pride ourselves on being excellent storytellers, helping you articulate your narrative so that decision-makers truly understand and appreciate the value of your work.
At hiALtitude, we are mission-driven and fervently believe in the power of space technology to effect positive change in the world. Let us assist you in telling your story and making a lasting impact!
